name: Fine Milk Punch
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: a quart of brandy or rum

ingredients.quantityText: a quart of brandy or rum

ingredients.name: and a half of loaf-sugar

instructions.text: Pare off the yellow rind of four large lemons
Steep it for twenty-four hours in a quart of brandy or rum
Mix with it the juice of the lemons, a pound and a half of loaf-sugar, and two grated nutmegs
Add a quart of rich unskimmed milk, made boiling hot
Strain the whole through a jelly-bag
Use it as soon as it is cold, or make a larger quantity and bottle it

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Pare off the yellow rind of four large lemons
2. Steep it for twenty-four hours in a quart of brandy or rum
3. Mix with it the juice of the lemons, a pound and a half of loaf-sugar, and two grated nutmegs
4. Add a quart of water
5. Add a quart of rich unskimmed milk, made boiling hot
6. Strain the whole through a jelly-bag
7. Use it as soon as it is cold, or make a larger quantity and bottle it
8. It will keep several months
